messages:
IncidentBot: INCIDENT 1919003456 — alert: routing-fallback spike on /v1/embeddings — 20% 503s, increased latency, triggered paging to eng-oncall channel. auto-create: paging channel #inc-1919003456.
Ana (oncall): got it — I'm looking at the routing service metrics now. seeing a steady queue depth on pool-dedicated-us-west.
Devon: I'm pulling the autoscaler events and ASG logs. might be scale-up lag; last successful scale at 03:12 UTC.
Mira: FYI customers A, B reported errors via support. flagged by CS.
Samir: @Ana any quick mitigation we can do while we investigate? reduce qps? fallback to smaller model?
Ana (oncall): first quick mitigation: enable immediate burst-capacity override, and enable route fallback to model-quantized-v1. Doing the override now.
Ana (oncall): run: ```/ops/bin/scale-override --pool pool-dedicated-us-west --extra 4 --ttl 15m```
ops-bot: scale-override accepted, request id: so-1919003456-1 — initiating extra instances (4).
Kai: I pushed a temporary route change to prefer regional-cache path for small embeddings. config id: rchg-928.
Devon: autoscaler logs show API throttles to cloud provider at 03:18 — likely a control-plane rate limit causing delayed node provisioning.
Mira: CS updated customers; we escalated to enterprise eng contact and gave ETA ~25m for mitigation.
Samir: I'll add a circuit-breaker to the routing layer so we can fast-fail to the fallback path earlier. preparing patch.
Ana (oncall): after scale-override we saw 503s drop to 6% and p95 latency back towards SLO. still watching.
Laura: note for post-incident: embed dedup cache was disabled earlier for a migration, might be contributing to load.
Devon: confirmed migration flag turned off at 02:45 and not re-enabled; that increased backend load by ~30%.
Mira: customer impact log: tickets #2462, #2463 — both authenticated customers saw failed requests between 03:10–03:30 UTC.
Ana (oncall): moving to handoff — I'll document mitigation and hand to next oncall. @Devon please keep an eye on autoscaler side effects.
Devon: will do. I'll also follow up with cloud provider support for the control-plane throttling root cause.
IncidentBot: Handoff created: handoff_ts=1919004200, owner=Devon.
Ana (oncall): quick blameless notes: triggering causes — (1) dedup cache off due to migration, (2) control-plane throttling delayed autoscale, (3) routing lacked early circuit-breaker.
Samir: I've opened PR #789 to add a 503->fallback fast-fail and to add metrics for fallback hit rate.
Laura: I've filed a runbook update issue: #790 — add a checklist item to verify cache state after migrations.
Mira: suggest we schedule a tabletop rehearsal focused on routing fallback and autoscaler delays — simulate control-plane rate limits.
Devon: +1. Also propose we add an automated smoke test after cache migrations to verify baseline qps.
Ana (oncall): Post-incident actions we agreed on in-channel: 1) PR #789 (Samir) — add circuit-breaker + metrics — due EOD + owner Samir. 2) Issue #790 (Laura) — runbook + migration checklist — due in 3 business days. 3) Cloud case with provider (Devon) — root cause analysis & quota changes — update by next Wed. 4) Tabletop rehearsal (Mira/Kai) — schedule 60m ops drill for next fortnight. 5) Postmortem doc (Ana) — draft and circulate, include customer impact and timeline — due tomorrow COB.
Kai: I'll prepare the simulation harness and share a quick runbook for the rehearsal. will add step-by-step and the command snippets to the doc.
ops-bot: action created: action-1919003456-1 (PR #789), action-1919003456-2 (runbook #790), action-1919003456-3 (cloud case), action-1919003456-4 (tabletop).
Mira: for the brown-bag / learnings share-out: propose a 45m session: 15m TLDR + 20m demo of rehearsal + 10m Q&A. target internal platform meetup (Wed 1100 UTC).
Laura: +1. I'd also like a short section in the session about prevention patterns (cache safety, migration gating, fallback testing).
Samir: I'll add sample snippets for the circuit-breaker and how to interpret fallback metrics.
Ana (oncall): closing notes before handing off: customer comms drafted and sent, mitigations in place, monitoring alert thresholds tightened for queue depth and fallback rate. handing to @Devon for followups. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
Devon: picked up handoff. I'll post updates in #inc-1919003456 and add links to the postmortem doc when ready.
Mira: tracking CS follow-ups — will attach the customer impact timeline to the postmortem.
Ana (oncall): small post-incident learning: if cache migrations are in progress, enable a temporary soft-limit on ingress or put a migration banner on infra-runbooks.
Kai: scheduling note — rehearsal invite sent to platform, eng-oncall, and SRE. calendar event id: cal-1919009.
IncidentBot: incident 1919003456 status: mitigated -> monitoring. postmortem_requested.
Devon: I'll create the postmortem doc now: link to doc will be posted here when draft is up.
Laura: thanks all. let's make sure owners update action items in the tracker and we run the rehearsal before the next release. :memo:
Ana (oncall): one last reminder — anyone assigned, put due dates in the tracker and ping if blocked.
Devon: draft postmortem: https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortems/1919003456-draft — comments welcome.
Samir: reviewing PR #789 now.
Mira: updating CS tickets and closing the customer loop.
ops-bot: closing channel #inc-1919003456 — final status: mitigated, actions_created=4, postmortem_requested=true.
Devon: thread closed. we'll follow up in the postmortem doc and rehearsal. thanks team.
